nodes.description: mapping(address => uint256) private _balances tracking token balances of every account
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private _allowances tracking spend approvals
uint256 private _totalSupply holding the total token supply
string private _name of the token, set once in the ERC20 constructor
string private _symbol of the token, set once in the ERC20 constructor
string private _version set by GeneratorCopyright constructor
string private constant _GENERATOR holding the generator URL
transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) public virtual override returns (bool); forwards to _transfer(_msgSender(), recipient, amount)
transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) public virtual override; moves tokens and decrements the caller allowance via _approve
approve(address spender, uint256 amount) public virtual override; calls _approve(_msgSender(), spender, amount)
increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue) public virtual; adds addedValue to the caller allowance and calls _approve
decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue) public virtual; checks current allowance and calls _approve with the reduced value
_transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) internal virtual; validates, invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook and updates _balances
_mint(address account, uint256 amount) internal virtual; mints new tokens, increases _totalSupply and _balances[account]
_burn(address account, uint256 amount) internal virtual; destroys tokens and decreases _balances[account] and _totalSupply
_approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount) internal virtual; writes _allowances[owner][spender]
_beforeTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal virtual hook invoked before every transfer, mint and burn
SimpleERC20 constructor(name_, symbol_, initialBalance_, feeReceiver_) payable; validates supply and mints the entire initial balance to _msgSender()
ServicePayer constructor(address payable receiver, string serviceName) payable; forwards msg.value to an external IPayable(receiver).pay call
IPayable.pay(string memory serviceName) external payable interface entry point executed on the receiver address
msg.sender obtained through Context._msgSender(); used as token owner, allowance holder and mint beneficiary
external value call IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName) executed on a caller-supplied address inside the constructor
recipient argument of transfer()
amount argument of transfer()
sender argument of transferFrom()
recipient argument of transferFrom()
amount argument of transferFrom()
spender argument of approve()
amount argument of approve()
spender argument of increaseAllowance()
addedValue argument of increaseAllowance(), added to the current allowance
spender argument of decreaseAllowance()
subtractedValue argument of decreaseAllowance(), subtracted from the current allowance
account argument of _mint(), the beneficiary address
amount argument of _mint(), the number of tokens created
name_ argument of the SimpleERC20 constructor
symbol_ argument of the SimpleERC20 constructor
initialBalance_ argument of the SimpleERC20 constructor, minted to msg.sender
feeReceiver_ argument of the SimpleERC20 constructor, forwarded to ServicePayer
receiver argument of the ServicePayer constructor, the target of the external pay call
serviceName argument passed as calldata to the external pay call
uint256 currentAllowance in transferFrom(), cached _allowances[sender][_msgSender()]
uint256 senderBalance in _transfer(), cached _balances[sender] before the subtraction
uint256 accountBalance in _burn(), cached _balances[account] before the subtraction
uint256 currentAllowance in decreaseAllowance(), checked against subtractedValue

edges.reason: transfer() delegates all balance mutation to the internal _transfer()
approve() delegates allowance writing to the internal _approve()
transferFrom() first moves tokens via _transfer()
transferFrom() reduces the caller allowance via _approve()
increaseAllowance() writes the new allowance via _approve()
decreaseAllowance() writes the reduced allowance via _approve()
_transfer() reads and writes _balances for both sender and recipient
_transfer() invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances
_mint() invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook with from == address(0)
_burn() invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook with to == address(0)
_mint() increases _balances[account] by amount
_mint() increases _totalSupply by amount
_burn() decreases _balances[account] by amount
_burn() decreases _totalSupply by amount
_approve() writes the amount into _allowances[owner][spender]
SimpleERC20 constructor mints the whole initial supply through _mint()
SimpleERC20 constructor runs the ServicePayer base constructor with feeReceiver_ and 'SimpleERC20'
ServicePayer constructor performs the external value-bearing pay call
the external call to the caller-supplied receiver can hand control to arbitrary code while the constructor still holds msg.value and pending initialization
the receiver parameter fully controls the destination address of the external call
serviceName is passed as calldata into the external pay call
feeReceiver_ is forwarded as the receiver argument of the ServicePayer constructor
initialBalance_ becomes the minted amount and is added to _totalSupply and the minter balance
msg.sender is the account that receives the entire minted initial supply
msg.sender is used as the debited sender of transfer()
msg.sender is the allowance owner written by approve()
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is read and reduced in transferFrom()
msg.sender is the allowance owner increased in increaseAllowance()
msg.sender is the allowance owner decreased in decreaseAllowance()
recipient parameter is forwarded to _transfer()
amount parameter is forwarded to _transfer()
sender parameter is the debited account of transferFrom()
recipient parameter is the credited account of transferFrom()
amount parameter is the value moved by transferFrom()
spender parameter is the allowance beneficiary of approve()
amount parameter is stored as the new allowance by approve()
spender parameter identifies the allowance entry increased
addedValue is added to the existing allowance value
spender parameter identifies the allowance entry decreased
subtractedValue is subtracted from the existing allowance value
account parameter receives the minted tokens
amount parameter is added to the balance and total supply during minting
name_ is passed to the ERC20 base constructor
symbol_ is passed to the ERC20 base constructor
initialBalance_ is validated and used as the mint amount in the constructor
feeReceiver_ is forwarded to the ServicePayer base constructor
recipient argument flows into _transfer() unchanged
amount argument is compared and subtracted from the sender balance in _transfer()
msg.sender becomes the sender argument of _transfer() when called from transfer()
currentAllowance is read from _allowances and drives the subtraction and require check in transferFrom()
senderBalance caches _balances[sender] before the checked subtraction in _transfer()
accountBalance caches _balances[account] before the checked subtraction in _burn()
currentAllowance is compared against subtractedValue before calling _approve()

normalization_plan.reason: recipient is a parameter local to transfer(), which owns its flow into _transfer()
amount is a parameter local to transfer(), consumed only by that entry point
sender is a parameter local to transferFrom()
recipient is a parameter local to transferFrom()
amount is a parameter local to transferFrom()
spender is a parameter local to approve()
amount is a parameter local to approve()
spender is a parameter local to increaseAllowance()
addedValue is a parameter local to increaseAllowance() and is added to the allowance
spender is a parameter local to decreaseAllowance()
subtractedValue is a parameter local to decreaseAllowance() and is subtracted from the allowance
account is the beneficiary parameter of the _mint() core function
amount is the value parameter of the _mint() core function
name_ is a constructor parameter of the SimpleERC20 core function
symbol_ is a constructor parameter of the SimpleERC20 core function
initialBalance_ is the constructor parameter that decides the minted amount
feeReceiver_ is the constructor parameter forwarded to ServicePayer and the external call
receiver directly determines the target of the unsafe external pay call
serviceName is the calldata argument of the unsafe external pay call
currentAllowance is a local computed and consumed entirely inside transferFrom()
senderBalance is a local computed and consumed entirely inside _transfer()
accountBalance is a local computed and consumed entirely inside _burn()
currentAllowance is a local computed and consumed entirely inside decreaseAllowance()
